description: List the merchant's stores (locations) with their addresses. Store ids are what the receipt, shift and inventory filters take. Loyverse: GET /stores.

created_at_max.description: Only records created at or before this time (ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-03-30T18:30:00.000Z).

created_at_min.description: Only records created at or after this time (ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-03-30T18:30:00.000Z).

show_deleted.description: Also return soft-deleted records (they carry deleted_at).

store_ids.description: Comma-separated list of store ids to return.

updated_at_max.description: Only records updated at or before this time (ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-03-30T18:30:00.000Z).

updated_at_min.description: Only records updated at or after this time (ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-03-30T18:30:00.000Z).

name: loyverse_list_stores
title: List stores
